The '''Commission for the Preservation of the New Order (COMPNOR)''' was a government agency for various entities of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that were designed to maintain support for [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].

==History==
[[File:Rally.jpg|thumb|left|The first COMPNOR rally in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], led by [[Ishin-Il-Raz]].]]

COMPNOR, which replaced the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|COMPOR]], originated as a popular ideological organization, and the Emperor quickly acted to draw it into his sphere of influence&mdash;within [[Galactic Standard Calendar|months]] of the Declaration of the New Order, the cultural and youth groups had been grafted onto the pre-existing framework of COMPOR. [[Crueya Vandron/Legends|Crueya Vandron]], one of the Emperor's [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]], played an important role in establishing COMPNOR as an asset of the Empire, with [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] and [[Ishin-Il-Raz]] also playing important roles. 

Initially appearing as a social movement primarily composed of younger and highly devoted followers of the Emperor, COMPNOR was soon transformed into a highly effective instrument of control through the manipulations of advisors like Vandron and Pestage. By filling its ranks with ideological loyalists and exploiting their personal hopes and fears, the Emperor constructed a massive body politic that extended into virtually every facet of Imperial governance and daily life.<ref name=":0">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Under the leadership of Vandron and Il-Raz, COMPNOR gained a powerful hold over the citizens of the Empire, and its organs insinuated themselves into every corner of society. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] (ISB) was established as a branch of COMPNOR to act as a counterweight to Imperial Intelligence, and it became the Emperor's all-pervasive secret police organization. The [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]] established monitoring agencies to keep track of all aspects of life. 

To secure long-term political dominance, COMPNOR indoctrinated the youth of the Empire through a retooled version of an old Republic education program. Youth were taught the absolute infallibility of Emperor Palpatine and the necessity of obedience to his will. Many were guided into political, military, educational, and civil service careers, ensuring a loyal generation of Imperial functionaries. This ideological grooming allowed COMPNOR to influence not only public opinion but also the future composition of the Empire's governing institutions.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" />

COMPNOR also influenced the Imperial bureaucracy, which was technically under the control of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. The organization was able to place its members, indoctrinated to be loyal to Emperor Palpatine, in every level of government bureaucracy, thus strengthening the Emperor's hold over the Empire. Through the elitist Select Committee, Palpatine enveloped key political, military, and economic leaders, drawing the galaxy’s most powerful figures into his personal service and ensuring COMPNOR’s continued influence at the highest levels of power. <ref name=":0" />

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Imperial Senate was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|suspended]] by direct order of Emperor Palpatine. The end of the Senate left the field wide open for COMPNOR to step in. For all the power of the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] and [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moffs]], COMPNOR stood behind them, still more powerful. 

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the COMPNOR, working closely with the Imperial Security Bureau, began hunting down and arresting civilian Rebel sympathizers. The Imperial response was especially brutal in regions where Rebel activity was known, targeting the general populace with harsh crackdowns.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], COMPNOR stated that it would give its support to the Imperial claimant [[Trioculus]] once he received the "dark blessing" of [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Rajah Ubooki|Kadann]].<ref name="The Lost City of the Jedi">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>

When Coruscant was retaken by the Empire in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]] decided that it was time to elect a new Galactic Emperor. COMPNOR officials along with various [[Admiral/Legends|admirals]], [[General/Legends|generals]], and Moffs disagreed, and an armed conflict soon broke out amongst the various Imperial factions on Coruscant.

==Ideology==
[[File:COMPNOR_SSD.jpg|thumb|right|200px|COMPNOR member on a public relations trip observes nearby fleet maneuvers.]]
The New Order, which was the underlying ideology of the Galactic Empire, was strongly supported by COMPNOR. It criticized the perceived decadence and weakness of the Republic, and advocated an authoritarian and militaristic social and political culture.

The [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] emphasized [[Human/Legends|Human]] and, to a lesser extent, [[near-Human]] supremacy, with other alien species like [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and [[Lurrian]]s subjected to discrimination or outright [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Antislavery laws were repealed and legislation legalizing the persecution of [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] was passed. As a result, the vast majority of the government officials were composed of Humans, with only rare exceptions like [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] climbing in the ranks of the military.

A high degree of [[Gender/Legends|male]] chauvinism was also seen in the Empire's military and government. Combining this with the alien persecution, the Empire was often referred to as having pro-HuMan policies.

==Structure==
[[File:Compnor_flowchart.jpg|thumb|right|220px|COMPNOR organization.]]

===Select Committee===
The [[Select Committee/Legends|Select Committee]] was the executive body for COMPNOR. The Select Committee had a variable number of members, and the COMPNOR charter provided for electoral and honorary means of being named a member of the Select Committee.

===Sub-Adult Group===
The [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]], or SAGroup, was COMPNOR's youth organization, and was made up of enthusiastic youths who firmly believed the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] was the best regime for [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and devoted their lives to upholding and respecting it.

===Coalition for Progress===
The [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]] was an information-gatherers agency of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. It began as a weak cultural organization, understaffed, and underwhelming, but developed into a massive information-gathering agency with monitors throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

It examined massive amounts of data, the majority of which was mundane, for indications of dissident or [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity, and forwarded summaries to the more-important [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]].

===Coalition for Improvements===
The [[Coalition for Improvements/Legends|Coalition for Improvements]] was a socio-political engineering agency of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. It was assigned to "improve" systems, which had deviated from the ideals of the New Order. These systems required long term solutions, and improvements were required to keep their work behind closed doors, as their solutions were typically not best associated with the Empire. 

In practice, it functions to align non-Human cultures with Imperial doctrine and to enhance the public image of politically significant individuals.<ref name="Rebellion Era Campaign Guide" />

===CompForce===
[[CompForce/Legends|CompForce]] was the military wing of COMPNOR, created to provide [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] with an army of utterly loyal soldiers separate from the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. Stormtroopers were trained to obey orders without thinking, but at the same time, they were proudly independent of the line military; CompForce units, in contrast, were embedded within the hierarchy of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], and their members were motivated primarily by conscious adherence to the tenets of the New Order. In theory, they were shock troops and officer candidates; in effect, they were security troops and [[Secret police|political police]], answerable to the New Order's ideologues rather than the High Command&mdash;an army within the Army, designed to tighten the grip of the Imperial hierarchy on the military.

===Imperial Security Bureau===
The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] was a part of the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order charged with maintaining morale and loyalty among members of the Imperial military and government, as well as policing its citizens.

==Membership==
Imperial citizens were encouraged to join COMPNOR. Members were given exclusive access to breaking news, a free subscription to ''[[Iron Will]]'', and a special welcome message from Palpatine himself. Anyone could join the organization, though the overwhelming majority of its members were Human.<ref>[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|''The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide'']]</ref>

Presumably, only Emperor Palpatine and a few other key Imperials, including [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]], [[Crueya Vandron/Legends|Lord Crueya Vandron]], and [[Ishin-Il-Raz]], knew exactly how many members there were on the Commission for the Preservation of the New Order. At the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], membership of Sub-Adult Group alone exceeded two trillion members.
